# The PMD edits that "save enhanced model" (menu 263) writes: English names
# (menu 259), a toon texture name (menu 261), and the physics model (menu
# 262); the save also sets the model path that the PMM records.
load model lips.pmd
english open
dialog text 667 "lips model"
dialog text 668 "An English comment"
dialog select 669 2
dialog text 672 UpperBody
dialog select 673 3
dialog text 676 oo
dialog select 677 1
dialog text 680 HairGroup
dialog ok
toon 3 toonx.bmp

physics model open
dialog text 718 2.5
dialog select 704 3
dialog text 712 0.25
dialog ok
save pmd edited.pmd
save pmm edited.pmm

english open
dialog text 667 cancelled
dialog cancel
save pmm cancelled.pmm
